text: 中国移动：2026年上半年，公司营运收入达到人民币5,380亿元，同比下降1.1%，同口径实现正增长。其中，主营业务收入达到人民币4,527亿元，同比下降3.1%；其他业务收入为人民币854亿元，同比增长11.2%。算力服务、智能服务收入占主营业务收入比达到22.6%，同比提升2.2个百分点。 股东应占利润为人民币789亿元，同比下降6.3%，同口径实现正增长，每股盈利为人民币3.64元；EBITDA为人民币1,736亿元，同比下降6.6%，EBITDA占主营业务收入比为38.4%；盈利能力保持全球一流运营商领先水平。经营现金净流入为人民币1,149亿元
text_en: China Mobile: In the first half of 2026, the company's operating revenue reached RMB 538 billion, down 1.1% year-on-year, but grew positively on a comparable basis. Among this, main business revenue reached RMB 452.7 billion, down 3.1% year-on-year; other business revenue was RMB 85.4 billion, up 11.2%. Revenue from computing power services and intelligent services accounted for 22.6% of main business revenue, up 2.2 percentage points year-on-year. Profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 78.9 billion, down 6.3% year-on-year, but grew positively on a comparable basis, with earnings per share of RMB 3.64; EBITDA was RMB 173.6 billion, down 6.6%, with EBITDA accounting for 38.4% of main business revenue; profitability maintained a leading level among global first-tier operators. Net operating cash inflow was RMB 114.9 billion.
